override:
services:
  postgres:
    env_file: !override ["<ephemeral-secret-file>"]
    ports: !override ["127.0.0.1::5432"]
    command: [postgres, -c, fsync=on, -c, synchronous_commit=on, -c, full_page_writes=on, -c, track_io_timing=on, -c, track_wal_io_timing=on]
server_version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg12+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 12.2.0-14+deb12u1) 12.2.0, 64-bit

unsupported.temp_peak_live_bytes: Snapshots cannot capture deleted temporary files; cumulative temp_bytes and temp I/O retained; peak qualification blocked.
unsupported.device_physical_bytes_and_fsync_latency: PostgreSQL counters describe OS calls, not device writes/cache flushes; device qualification blocked.

metric_support.pg_stat_io: supported; null cells unsupported for backend/object/context
metric_support.fsync_count_time: pg_stat_io fsyncs/fsync_time; null cells unsupported; interpret with wal_sync_method
